forms:
record_usage: key model: model tokens: tokens
	(state at: 'calls' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ]) add: { 'key' -> key. 'model' -> model. 'tokens' -> tokens } asDictionary.
	^ self usage: key

usage: key
	^ (state at: 'calls' ifAbsent: [ #() ]) inject: 0 into: [ :sum :c | (c at: 'key') = key ifTrue: [ sum + (c at: 'tokens') ] ifFalse: [ sum ] ]

set_price: model cents: cents
	(state at: 'prices' ifAbsentPut: [ Dictionary new ]) at: model put: cents.
	^ cents

cost: key
	| prices cents |
	prices := state at: 'prices' ifAbsent: [ Dictionary new ].
	cents := (state at: 'calls' ifAbsent: [ #() ]) inject: 0 into: [ :sum :c |
		(c at: 'key') = key
			ifTrue: [ sum + ((c at: 'tokens') / 1000.0 * (prices at: (c at: 'model') ifAbsent: [ 0 ])) ]
			ifFalse: [ sum ] ].
	^ cents rounded / 100.0

set_quota: key tokens: tokens
	(self usage: key) > tokens ifTrue: [ ^ self error: 'already over that quota' ].
	(state at: 'quotas' ifAbsentPut: [ Dictionary new ]) at: key put: tokens.
	^ tokens

record_usage: key model: model tokens: tokens
	| quota |
	quota := (state at: 'quotas' ifAbsent: [ Dictionary new ]) at: key ifAbsent: [ nil ].
	(quota notNil and: [ (self usage: key) + tokens > quota ]) ifTrue: [ ^ self error: 'over quota' ].
	(state at: 'calls' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ]) add: { 'key' -> key. 'model' -> model. 'tokens' -> tokens } asDictionary.
	^ self usage: key

record_usage: key model: model tokens: tokens
	| quota |
	(key isString and: [ key isEmpty not ]) ifFalse: [ ^ self error: 'key required' ].
	(model isString and: [ model isEmpty not ]) ifFalse: [ ^ self error: 'model required' ].
	(tokens isNumber and: [ tokens > 0 and: [ tokens fractionPart = 0 ] ]) ifFalse: [ ^ self error: 'tokens must be a positive whole number' ].
	quota := (state at: 'quotas' ifAbsent: [ Dictionary new ]) at: key ifAbsent: [ nil ].
	(quota notNil and: [ (self usage: key) + tokens > quota ]) ifTrue: [ ^ self error: 'over quota' ].
	(state at: 'calls' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ]) add: { 'key' -> key. 'model' -> model. 'tokens' -> tokens truncated } asDictionary.
	^ self usage: key

top_spender
	| keys best |
	keys := ((state at: 'calls' ifAbsent: [ #() ]) collect: [ :c | c at: 'key' ]) asSet asArray sorted.
	best := nil.
	keys do: [ :k | (best isNil or: [ (self cost: k) > (self cost: best) ]) ifTrue: [ best := k ] ].
	^ best
